title: fix(types): a `page` node refuses `maxWidth` and `padding` by name; the layout guide teaches `pageType` and the `container` (objectui#11318)
body:
Fixes #11318

Clause-②: no

The layout guide taught `maxWidth` and `padding: false` on a `page` node. Neither is a page key: both are `container` members, `PageNodeSchema` declared neither, and `PageRenderer` reads neither. This PR makes the page node refuse both by name, with the door that works in the message, and corrects the guide.

Dispatched by the PM loop (claim comment `5943320845`, triage direction `5924850908`); implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`. Not a governed surface: `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the eight paths answers NOT GOVERNED.

On the Clause-② line: the claim's reason says the change moves the message, not the accept set. That holds for the strict face, which already refused both keys. On the tolerant face (`safeValidateSchema`, what `objectui validate` runs today) this PR **narrows** the accept set: a page carrying either key used to pass and is now refused. A narrowing is not a widening, so the declaration stays `no`.

## What changed

- `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`: `PageNodeSchema` declares `maxWidth` and `padding` as `retirementTombstone` arms (`PAGE_MAX_WIDTH_REFUSAL`, `PAGE_PADDING_REFUSAL`). The `maxWidth` message names `pageType`, and a wrapping `container` with its own `maxWidth`. The `padding` message names a wrapping `container` with its own `padding`. This is the shape `actions` (objectui#7926) and `breadcrumbs` (objectui#8871) set on the same node. The node stays open, not `.strict()`.
- `packages/types/src/layout.ts`: the TypeScript twin declares both keys `?: never`, with docblocks.
- `content/docs/guide/layout.md`: the four snippets and the Schema API block are corrected, and each place that taught a key gets a refusal callout. The per-site table below has the details.
- `page-app-dashboard-spec-parity.test.ts`: the Page `local` ledger row lists the two new refusals. Its note asked that a third refusal come with a census, so the note now records that census and says four.
- New pin `page-width-padding-refusal-11318.test.ts`. `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` records it as a reader of the guide. Its `--audit` refused the new pin until that row existed.
- Changeset `11318-page-width-padding-refusal.md` (`@object-ui/types`: minor, breaking for a page node carrying either key).
- `packages/layout/src/__tests__/guide-layout-app-shell-doc.test.ts`: a comment only. Its scope note said the page Schema API declares `headerClassName` / `bodyClassName`, which this PR made false (Acceptance notes).

## Per-site decisions

| Section (by heading) | Before | After | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Schema API | `maxWidth?`, `padding?`, `headerClassName?`, `bodyClassName?` on the page shape | `pageType?`, plus two NO lines naming the refusals | `pageType` is the declared width control. The two className lines are an in-place fix (Acceptance notes). |
| Max Width Options, now Content Width | `"maxWidth": "lg"` and a list of sizes | `"pageType": "utility"`, plus a second snippet: a `container` with `"maxWidth": "2xl"` | The section is about the page's own width, and that is `pageType`. A narrower column is a container. |
| Settings Page with Tabs | `"maxWidth": "2xl"` | `"pageType": "utility"` | A settings page is a utility page. |
| Page Padding | `"padding": false` on the page, container `"className": "p-8"` | container `"padding": 8` and `"maxWidth": false` | The page's inset is fixed, and the declared padding control is the container's. `maxWidth: false` keeps the container page-wide instead of its default `xl` cap. |
| 4. Max Width for Forms, now 4. Constrained Width for Forms | `"maxWidth": "lg"` on the page | `"pageType": "utility"`, and a `container` with `"maxWidth": "2xl"` around the form | The passage is about a narrow column for a form, which is a container. |

`pageType: "utility"` matters for the snippets with a `title` too. A page with no `pageType` is a `record` page, and a record page leaves its heading to a `page:header` block, so its `title` draws nothing (measured below). The Content Width section says so in one sentence.

## Measurements (BASE `0858267e4`)

The dispatch's four mechanism assumptions, each measured:

1. **Confirmed.** `PageNodeSchema` declared neither key; `ContainerSchema` declares both. Measured with one-time render probes through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry (not committed):
   - A page with `maxWidth: 'lg'` drew the inner class `mx-auto space-y-6 max-w-7xl`, the same as the page without the key. The DOM had no `maxwidth` attribute.
   - A page with `padding: false` kept the wrapper class `min-h-full w-full bg-background p-3 md:p-4 lg:p-6`, the same as the control.
   - With `headerClassName` / `bodyClassName` on the page, neither class value appeared anywhere in the DOM.
   - Corrected `pageType: 'utility'` drew an inner `max-w-4xl` and the heading. `app` drew `max-w-screen-xl`, `home` drew `max-w-screen-2xl`, and the default `record` drew `max-w-7xl`. Compiled with the repo's Tailwind 4.3.3, `max-w-7xl` and `max-w-screen-xl` are both 80rem. So the guide says `record`, `list` and `app` share a cap and `home` is the widest, and it cites `getPageMaxWidth` for the mapping rather than copying sizes.
   - The corrected container with `maxWidth: '2xl'` drew `w-full max-w-2xl mx-auto p-2 sm:p-3 md:p-4`. The container with `padding: 8` drew `p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8`.
2. **Confirmed, so item 2 of the direction was not a no-op.** On the four fences as written, the tolerant face passed and kept the key. The strict face refused with a bare `unrecognized_keys` (`Unrecognized key: "maxWidth"` / `"padding"`) and no prescription. After this PR, both faces answer `invalid_type` at the key's own path, with the prescription.
3. **Decided per site:** see the table above.
4. **No overlap with objectui#11069.** That PR edits the paragraph under "With Action Buttons" that begins "`label` is the button's text key". This PR touches neither that paragraph nor any line next to it.

Census: every git-tracked JSON file and `json` fence in `.md`/`.mdx` (24 `type: "page"` objects read), plus every TS/TSX/JS object literal through the TypeScript AST (193 `type: 'page'` literals). Key-matcher control: 28 hits for `title` / `pageType`. The only page objects carrying either key were the four guide fences, so the refusals strand no authored document in the tree. This is a reading on the base, not a live count.

## Tests and gates (head `0c61074`)

- One run of the whole `packages/types/` suite plus the 18 reader and script files below → `Test Files 341 passed (341)`, `Tests 9065 passed (9065)`. On its own, `packages/types/` is 323 files and 8632 tests. That includes the new pin: 28 tests, both faces per key, and every page fence of the guide through both faces.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (script name echoed: `type-check`) → exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new pin, so its `@ts-expect-error` legs are compiled.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` → `✓ dist completeness: 1 package(s) complete (142 emitted files verified)`. `dist/layout.d.ts` carries `maxWidth?: never` and `padding?: never`.
- Guide readers and the changed script's own suite (18 files, 433 tests, in the run above) cover `scripts/__tests__/markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` plus the nine other test files that name the script, `guide-layout-page-buttons-7926`, the five `packages/layout` guide pins, `component-node-vocabulary-7434` and `doc-version-claims`.
- `check:doc-types` ✅ · `check:doc-fences` ✅ · `check:doc-example-ids` ✅ (415 references resolve) · `check-doc-links.mjs` "Links are valid across 17 scan roots." · `check:control-bytes` ✅ · `check:new-line-citations` "VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)" · `check:spec-symbols` ✅ · `check:doc-example-readers` OK · `check-changeset-presence` ✅ (5 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset; the layout test sits under `src/`) · `check-changeset-fixed` ✅ · `check-changeset-no-major` ✅ · `check-changeset-overwrite` ✅ · `check:pending-changeset-literals` ✅ · `check-test-path-roots` ✅ · `check-type-check-coverage` ✅ · `check-lint-coverage` ✅ · `check:unreferenced-sources` OK · `markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit` "111 candidate test files, all adjudicated".
- eslint on the changed lintable files, as a proven narrowing. ① Population: `eslint --print-config` applies 116 to 118 rules to each of the five package files and 0 to `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`, which sits outside the linted population. ② `--format json` reports 6 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. ③ Invariance: the config extends `tseslint.configs.recommended`, sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the file system, so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- **NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples`.** Reason: both exit 2 on an unbuilt tree, and their build closure is 34 packages, which does not fit the foreground cap. Basis for the narrowing: `check:doc-snippets` judges only ts/tsx fences. This diff adds or removes none, and the one it edits (Schema API) carries a `doc-snippet: fragment` declaration the gate skips. `check:doc-examples` judges JSDoc `@example` blocks, and this diff adds none. CI's `doc-snippet-types.yml` runs both.
- **NOT MEASURED: the downstream type-check sweep (`...@object-ui/types`).** The TS face gains two `?: never` members. The AST census above found no `type: 'page'` literal writing either key anywhere in the tree, and reading a `never`-typed optional still compiles. CI runs every package's `type-check`. `@object-ui/layout`'s own `type-check` was not run either: its one change here is a comment.

Ablations (one-time, each through `ablation-replace.mjs` from committed head `92cbe41`, and no file they mutated or ran has changed since; restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`):

- Delete the two zod tombstone lines → **10 failed / 38 passed**. All ten are contract-half legs: declared, refused at the key on each face, remedy named on each face. The positive controls and remedy legs stayed green, as predicted.
- Re-plant `"maxWidth": "lg"` in the Content Width fence → **3 failed / 25 passed**: both faces over the guide, plus the page-key scan. The failing line reads `Content Width: invalid_type at maxWidth`.
- Delete `maxWidth?: never` from the TS twin → `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2. The output shows `TS2578 Unused '@ts-expect-error'` in the new pin and two `TS2322` errors in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, so the twin pair is enforced from both sides.

## Acceptance notes

- **In-place fix, beyond the card's two keys:** the Schema API block also declared `headerClassName?` and `bodyClassName?` on the page shape. Neither is declared on `PageNodeSchema`, and both are refused as bare `unrecognized_keys` by the strict face. The render probe drew neither class anywhere. The two lines were the only place in the tree teaching them, and they sat in the block this PR rewrites. So they are removed from the guide only, with no schema change: the triage direction names two keys, and with zero teaching sites and zero authored sites left, a named refusal for them has no pull. `git grep` over the tree finds no other page-node use of either spelling; the remaining hits are `AppShell` prose, `VirtualGrid`'s own prop, and a local variable in `RelatedList`.
- **In-place fix, same cause:** `guide-layout-app-shell-doc.test.ts` explained its narrow scan by saying the page Schema API declares `headerClassName` / `bodyClassName`. That stopped being true here, so the sentence is restated without it. Comment only; the file is in the 18-file set above.
- **Out of scope, reported to the seat rather than filed:** a `page` with a `title` and no `pageType` draws no heading and no description. Other guide passages author that shape: Page Component › Basic Usage, With Action Buttons, Detail Page with Actions, and Best Practices § 3. The render probe on the Basic Usage fence verbatim left only the child's text in the DOM. The same fence with `pageType: "utility"` drew both.
- **Out of scope, reported to the seat rather than filed:** `ContainerSchema.padding` is a bare `z.number()`, while the `container` renderer maps only a closed set of values. `padding: 9` and `padding: 20` pass both faces and render no padding class at all, not even the default. The corrected Page Padding passage points readers at the Container reference for the scale.
